name: Virgilia Senier
source:
Known in the Uteme-Lovond Academy as the "Golden Age Teacher".
Virgilia was an ideal teacher and always had a universal approach to each student. The reason for her departure from the Academy is unknown.
According to the Longevity system, Virgilia is a top-ranking mtsyr.
